name: Octo Rally
tagline: Eight sides. Four balls. Guard your gap.
description: Slide your paddle along one side of an octagonal arena. Save the balls to protect your five lives as more balls join the rally. Empty sides and eliminated players become walls. Be the last paddle standing, or keep the most lives when the one-minute clock runs out; saves break a tie.
howToPlay: Slide left or right on your phone to move your paddle along your numbered side.
Start with five lives. A ball past your paddle costs one; at zero, watch the rally.
Balls join every 15s. Last paddle wins; at 60s, lives lead and saves break ties.
